detailed_description:
The target video is in a dreamy, ethereal fantasy style with soft diffused daylight, a pale pink-and-white palette, and gentle slow-motion movement.
[Shot 1] The shot opens on the exact frame of <Picture 1>: inside <Subject 2>, a high-angle wide shot looks down at <Subject 1> lying on the petal-carpeted floor, her entire figure formed from densely layered pink petals, long petal hair fanning across the floor, eyes closed. Soft daylight pours through the tall window on the left while loose petals drift down slowly through the light. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed. Around 00:02.000, the petals surrounding her body begin to tremble and swirl inward, streaming onto her torso and limbs; the petal figure subtly rises from the petal bed as if surfacing from still water, thin streams of petals sliding off her arms and chest and rejoining the floor.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close side shot of <Subject 1>. A soft ripple travels over her body from head to toe: the layered petals loosen, flatten, and melt into smooth pale skin, while her petal hair releases into long platinum-white strands woven with small pink flowers. A few petals remain clinging to her shoulders, collarbone, and lap. Her face turns lifelike — her lashes flutter, her eyes slowly open, and her gaze catches the window light as faint warmth blooms across her cheeks. The camera tilts up with small amplitude from her resting hands to her awakened face.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.000, the camera cuts to a medium shot from a slightly lower angle. <Subject 1> presses one hand into the petal floor and gracefully sits up, her long hair spilling over one shoulder; petals cascade from her arms and torso in slow motion, drifting back down onto the floor. She turns her face toward the window and settles into the exact seated pose of <Picture 2> — back straight, one hand resting on the petals, calm gaze toward the light — as the last drifting petals land around her and the camera holds still on the final frame.

overall_soundscape: A soft, airy breeze drifts through the window, carrying the delicate rustle of slowly falling petals. Fine petal-on-petal whispering builds as the petals swirl and gather around her body, followed by gentle cascading rustles as petals slide off her and settle back onto the floor.

non_diegetic_music: A slow, ethereal arrangement of soft piano notes, airy string pads, and delicate harp arpeggios plays at a gentle tempo, gradually swelling in dynamics as the transformation unfolds and resolving into a quiet, sustained chord as she sits up.
